messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: Simple ListBox Input?
parts:
I notice that if I use 

selectInput(..., multiple=TRUE, selectize = FALSE)

I get a simple listbox. But if I set 

multiple=FALSE

, it changes back to a combobox (with a dropdown) again. How can I have a single-selection listbox? I find it easier to use (saves a click) when the number of choices is small. Am I missing something simple or this actually requires creating a custom widget? Thanks.
